crime: On the first night, a girl took {WITCH_NAME}'s outstretched hand and returned her squeeze. In recent days, {WITCH_NAME} had kept asking the girl to squeeze again, to prove they were still friends.

Today, the girl refused to keep proving it. Seated facing outward on the upper railing, she let go and drew her hand away. From the courtyard, {WITCH_NAME} used her Magic to catch the girl's wrist in both hands and yank her headfirst off the railing. The girl's head struck the path, killing her.

Afterward, {WITCH_NAME} claimed the girl had already been falling when she reached out to catch her. But a prisoner recalled watching from the second-floor hall: the girl had demanded to be let go while still sitting steadily on the railing. As the prisoner pointed out, {WITCH_NAME} had already been holding her before there was any fall to stop.
fields.epitaph: The hand that never let go never answered.
fields.epithet: An open palm begging for an answer
execution: A glass tank on the execution stand holds her strapped to a seat. An iron hand clasps hers as the water rises over her face. Her submerged body goes still; the iron hand keeps hold.

magic.name: Within Reach
magic.text: She can physically touch distant people and objects as though they were within reach.
